title: Insight metadata message
description: The envelope every metadata message has, whatever its type. Version 1 of the contract in docs/contracts.md. Unknown top-level fields are allowed and ignored. The $defs hold the parts the type schemas share.

type.description: Which overlay draws the message: object-detection, classification, tracking, pose-estimation or segmentation. Insight ignores a type it does not know.

timestamp.description: The presentation time of the video frame the message describes, in whole milliseconds on the frame's RTP clock: pts_ns // 1_000_000 for a Neat sample. Leave it out when unknown; a negative value counts as absent. A message without one is drawn on the next frame shown.

frame_id.description: The producer's own frame identifier, for diagnostics only. Any JSON value; a string is recommended. Insight never matches by it.

data.description: The payload, as the type defines it.

$comment: _insight is reserved: Insight adds it to the messages it forwards to the browser, and a producer must not send it.

bbox.description: An axis-aligned box [x, y, width, height] in pixels of the video frame, origin at the top-left corner, x to the right and y down. Fractions are allowed.

confidence.description: A score from 0 to 1, shown as a percentage.

label.description: The class name. It picks the overlay color, so one class has one color.

id.description: An identity the producer keeps stable from frame to frame, compared as a string.
